name: Multiset.lists_coe
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
inst✝ : DecidableEq α
l : List α
⊢ Eq (↑l).lists l.permutations.toFinset
decl:
@[simp]
theorem lists_coe (l : List α) : lists (l : Multiset α) = l.permutations.toFinset :=
  rfl

name: Multiset.mem_lists_iff
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
inst✝ : DecidableEq α
s : Multiset α
l : List α
⊢ Iff (Membership.mem s.lists l) (Eq s (Quotient.mk (List.isSetoid α) l))
decl:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lists_iff (s : Multiset α) (l : List α) : l ∈ lists s ↔ s = ⟦l⟧ := by
  induction s using Quotient.inductionOn
  simpa using perm_comm
